verdict.rationale: Relay is a business banking platform, so a universal search bar that leads into payment initiation is a fair axis to ask about. The evidence pack never mentions any search capability across transactions, vendors, and cards. Real-time transaction tracking and vendor bill pay are separate features and do not show unified search or a jump-to-pay flow.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can search across all transactions, vendors, and cards from one universal search bar and jump straight into initiating a payment
